description: Official MCP server for twitterapis.com. Read and write Twitter/X: search, users, tweets, DMs.
name: io.github.TwitterAPIs/twitterapis-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Your twitterapis.com API key. Create one at https://www.twitterapis.com/dashboard. Required: every tool call authenticates with it.
environmentVariables.name: TWITTERAPIS_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.twitterapis.com. Only set this if you were given a different endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: TWITTERAPIS_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Raise it if you page through large follower lists on a slow link.
environmentVariables.name: TWITTERAPIS_TIMEOUT_MS

title: TwitterAPIs
